paite: Huchi in Tura kumpipa Hiram in David kiang ah sawltak mite asawl a, sidar singte, suangsek mite, khutsiam mite, inn lamsak ding in.
heading: Jerusalem A David Nasepte / (2 Sam 5.11-16)
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

paite: David in Israel tung ah TOUPA'N amah kumpipa in akoihkipta chih athei a, agam lah, ami Israelte, sangpi a tawisang in a-omta hi.
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

paite: David in Jerusalem ah zite tamsem api a: huchi in David in tapate leh tanute tamsem asuangta hi.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

paite: Hiaite Jerusalem a aneih tate minte ahi; Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon;
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel tengteng tung ah kumpipa a David thaunilh ahi chih azak un, David zong ding in Philistia mite tengteng akuantou ua: David in huai azak in, amaute dou ding in akuankheta hi.
heading: Philistiate Tung A Vualzohna / (2 Sam 5.17-25)
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

paite: Philistia mite ahong ua, Rephaim Phaizang atuam uhi.
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: Huchi in David in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite dou ding in ka kuantou diam? Amau ka khut ah na hon pe diam?" chi in. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Kuantou in; na khut a amaute hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

paite: Huchi in Baal-perazim ah ahong tou ua, David in amau athat a; huchi in David in, "Pathian in tui khah bang in ka khut in ka melmate ahihsia," achi a. Huaiziak in huai mun min ding in Baal-perazim asa hi.
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

paite: Huai ah apathiante uh anusia ua; David in thupiak apia a, mei in ahal uhi.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

paite: Huchih nung in Philistiate'n phaizang atuam nawn lai uhi.
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

paite: David in Pathian thu adong nawn a; Pathian in akiang ah, "Amau delh ding in na kuantou kei ding: amau kihei mangsan inla, singtheimi singte zawntak ah amau sual in,” achi hi.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

paite: "Singthei mi singte dawn a taiging na zak chiang in; huai chiang in kidou ding in na kuankhe ding hi: Philistia mihonte that ding in na ma ah Pathian akuankheta chihna ahi ding hi," achi hi.
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in Pathian in amah thu apiak bang in David in ahih a: Gibeon a kipan Gezer pha in Philistia mihonpi athatta uhi.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

paite: Huan gam tengteng ah David min athangkheta a; huchi in TOUPA'N nam tengteng tung ah amah launa atungsakta hi.
english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.
